additional_info.subject: ID0481513-DC/Si-D/FR-[RVP/T3170004583] False Cable Theft CRM:02889001225
additional_info.body:
Hi Richard, good afternoon.
We received several requests from this French customer "Picoty" regarding the onboarding of some chargers on MSE Portal:
“The charger is not appearing on the MSE portal. Could you please take the necessary steps to ensure that all our chargers appear on the MSE portal? While you're at it, is it possible to use the account
exploitation.irve@picoty.fr
as requested?”
There are already 2 tickets, as far as I know since i'm the owner, regarding this topic. I would like to know how it should be handled so that I can also share with the team afterwards.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Franciscp

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0481513-DC/Si-D/FR-[RVP/T3170004583] False Cable Theft CRM:02889001225
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco,
There are two possibilities:
He is not related to the right account, then that needs to be changed in his contact.
Or he the right account does not contain all the chargers that belong to it. Then those chargers need to be added.
There are several PICOTY accounts. Can it be that they need to be merged?
